correction.scope: Notation only: Euler's number in the binary-entropy envelope is written as \mathrm e to distinguish it from the support-error variable e. No theorem changes.

claims.statement: Let x be a centered genuine Boolean derivative row of influence p, and let its sensitivity support E differ from a codimension-r coordinate subcube Q on physical controls Z, of measure q=2^{-r}, by e=mu(E triangle Q). If I_Z<=r p and e<=q/(8r), then the physical control restriction obeys Delta_Z H<=12 I_Z. Derivative signs are unrestricted.

dependencies.section: Sections B-C: punctured-cube variance and full-cube log-Sobolev restriction-mixture estimates

claims.verification: Complete analytic proof in REPORT.md Section 2; no finite computation used.

claims.statement: Under the same hypotheses, e<=p/(8r-1), and the physical posterior crossing satisfies c_x(Z)>=(1-1/(8r-1))p. Thus the robust trigger-surplus theorem applies with codimension-dependent relative tolerance eta_r=1/(8r-1), rather than a fixed relative tolerance.

Under the same hypotheses, revealing the original physical block A=Z union {x} removes the entire near-subcube row and obeys Delta_A H<=12 I_A. The residual pivot cost after revealing Z is at most Psi(e)<=3p/2.

claims.verification: Complete analytic proof in REPORT.md Section 4.

claims.statement: An adaptive physical tree that repeatedly removes any row satisfying the q/(8r) condition spends total Shannon entropy at most 12[J(root)-E J(leaf)]<=12J(root). Locally Delta_A F<=12D_A-[12C_A+L_A+W_A+R_A], so folded crossings and phase/curvature refunds are retained and cannot be reused after recentering.
